title: Why the Charger wins
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: Last night's evolution run produced a Charger that beats the starting tanks 99% of the time. It isn't the build: give its 3-4-2 build to the ordinary scripted Charger and it wins about half its fights. It's the charge. Evolution taught it to never stop short and steer loosely, so it bulldozes into its target while dodging as often as the rules allow, and Kiters and Snipers can't get away to shoot from range.

We tested 22 rule changes in about 105,000 matches each. The proposal treats the Charger's approach the way we already treat its dodge: evolution may make it more careful than the scripted Charger, never more reckless. With that, the best tank wins 64% against the field, every preset wins at least 52% with its best behavior, and the counter triangle stays as it is. Nothing changes until Nye decides.
next: Nye decides. If it's a yes, the change ships with a fresh evolution run and a re-pinned M1 champion.
